acceptance_criteria.description: Registration obtains CSRF with no-store/same-origin credentials and posts only displayName, email, and password with the required CSRF header.
HTTP 422 field errors are preserved and attached to the corresponding registration fields, while entered values remain available after failure.
HTTP 409 produces safe duplicate-email guidance linking the user to sign-in.
HTTP 201 clears password state and shows an account-created sign-in success state without creating a session or routing to /app.
